comment: Watermarks for the Supabase word-review pass: every candidate the game recorded
up to `reviewed_through` has been judged, so the next pass only has to look at
rows newer than the latest entry here.
`reviewed_through` is the newest `analytics_events.created_at` that existed when
the pass ran -- the queue query's own horizon -- and is the value to filter on:
The per-word record of each verdict lives in two places: `word_sightings.status`
this repo, src/data/word-rejections.json for a rejection and the provenance
lists in scripts/ for an acceptance.

sources: analytics_events.answer_rejected (658 submissions, 590 distinct, 554 not on the curated list)
notes: Accepted words went to scripts/suggested-words.txt and dictionary.json;
`reoxygenate` also got a score override onto `oxygenate`, since re- + a
common verb is a prefix, not a discovery.
Rejections went to src/data/word-rejections.json with the fault named
(misspelling, proper noun, abbreviation, obsolete, or judged non-word).
Nonsense strings nobody repeated were left to the generic message rather
than filling the file with one-off typos.
